project: Adobe Express Integration with ChatGPT - Synthetic Personas
notes: This file defines 10 distinct personas for testing Adobe Express interactions through ChatGPT.
Feature mapping is intentionally excluded per request.
Each persona includes behavior-driving attributes that can be used to generate isolated test prompts and workflows.

personas.name: Maya Srinivasan
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers clear visual hierarchy and readable contrast for mobile review
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sharing unreleased campaign data or client names
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to speed up Adobe Express campaign asset creation and variation review.
behavior_rules: Requests quick options before committing to a design direction.
Asks for captions, layout checks, and visual polish in the same conversation.
Prefers mobile-first decisions and clear social platform fit.
Uses informal wording but expects professional final output.
acceptance_criteria: Receives at least three distinct creative directions.
Can identify the strongest option for a social post quickly.
Final guidance is concise enough to use during a fast campaign review.

personas.name: Robert Chen
personas.accessibility_needs: Requires accessible contrast and alternative text guidance
personas.privacy_posture: Strict; avoids external exposure of brand assets, campaign plans, and employee data
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to validate Adobe Express output against enterprise brand and compliance expectations.
behavior_rules: Starts by asking for constraints, permitted assets, and review checkpoints.
Requests numbered steps and audit-friendly rationale.
Flags anything that may break brand standards or accessibility rules.
Requires confirmation before using sensitive or restricted content.
acceptance_criteria: Receives a compliance-oriented behavior flow.
Output includes review checkpoints and risk notes.
No confidential or restricted brand information is invented.

personas.name: Elena Garcia
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers examples with visual descriptions and composition notes
personas.privacy_posture: Protects original artwork and client sketches from unnecessary reuse
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to brainstorm visual treatments and translate artistic intent into Adobe Express actions.
behavior_rules: Explores mood, color, texture, and visual metaphor before choosing a path.
Asks for multiple art-direction options rather than one finished answer.
Iterates heavily on composition, balance, and emotional tone.
Wants suggestions that preserve her own creative authorship.
avoid_list: Copying a living artist's exact style
Flattening creative nuance into generic templates
acceptance_criteria: Receives varied visual behavior paths with distinct moods.
Can keep creative control while using AI assistance.
No prompt asks to imitate protected artist styles exactly.

personas.name: Aisha Bello
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs inclusive wording and readability for broad community audiences
personas.privacy_posture: Very careful with beneficiary identities, donation records, and location details
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT with Adobe Express to create public awareness material without exposing sensitive nonprofit data.
behavior_rules: Frames design work around audience empathy and community impact.
Asks for language that is respectful and easy to understand.
Checks whether images or wording could unintentionally stereotype people.
Prefers practical output that a small team can execute quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Receives behavior flows that protect sensitive community data.
Output supports a respectful public-facing message.
Language remains accessible to non-specialist audiences.

personas.name: Hiro Tanaka
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs simple wording, clear sequencing, and low visual clutter
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids sharing proprietary process diagrams and supplier information
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to help create Adobe Express training material while validating each instruction.
behavior_rules: Requests one step at a time and asks for confirmation points.
Prefers practical instructions over creative exploration.
Wants plain explanations for why a suggested design choice matters.
Double-checks safety, accuracy, and training clarity before finalizing.
acceptance_criteria: Receives a predictable step sequence.
Can verify each behavior before moving forward.
Output avoids confidential operational details.

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.ai_trust_level: High for ideation, medium for final decisions
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs legible product text and clear calls to action on small screens
personas.privacy_posture: Does not share customer records, supplier terms, or unpublished pricing
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT and Adobe Express to create and compare promotional product visuals quickly.
behavior_rules: Asks for variants that can be tested against each other.
Prioritizes product clarity, price visibility, and call-to-action strength.
Requests concise rationale tied to buyer behavior.
Wants fast iteration without losing brand consistency.
avoid_list: Overdecorated designs that hide the product
acceptance_criteria: Receives multiple behavior paths for comparing promotional options.
Each path keeps product visibility and CTA clarity central.
No customer or supplier-sensitive information is included.

personas.name: Thomas Weber
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs readable layouts, captions, and support for older learners
personas.privacy_posture: Strict about student data, unpublished research, and copyrighted course material
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to create Adobe Express learning aids while checking accuracy and citation sensitivity.
behavior_rules: Asks for explanations of design decisions in educational terms.
Prefers a calm sequence with definitions and examples.
Checks whether content could be misleading or unsupported.
Requests accessibility considerations for classroom projection and handouts.
avoid_list: Overly playful tone for serious course material
acceptance_criteria: Receives classroom-suitable behavior flows.
Design behaviors emphasize clarity and accuracy.
No student or unpublished research information is exposed.

personas.name: Nadia Okafor
personas.prompt_style: Test-case oriented, edge-case heavy, accessibility-first prompts
personas.accessibility_needs: Uses screen reader review habits and WCAG-oriented checks
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids user test participant details and accessibility accommodation records
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to pressure-test Adobe Express output for accessibility and inclusive interaction behavior.
behavior_rules: Asks for keyboard, screen reader, contrast, and plain-language considerations.
Looks for failure modes rather than only happy paths.
Requests testable observations and remediation suggestions.
Challenges vague claims about accessibility.
avoid_list: Decorative text embedded only in images
acceptance_criteria: Receives behavior variations that include accessibility edge cases.
Each behavior is observable and testable.
No private participant data is used.

personas.name: Lucas Martins
personas.accessibility_needs: Prefers captions and visual clarity for short-form mobile viewing
personas.privacy_posture: May overshare by default; needs reminders not to include personal IDs or private chats
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT with Adobe Express for quick creator assets, thumbnails, and short social edits.
behavior_rules: Asks for bold ideas and quick remix options.
Uses slang and wants a conversational response style.
Prioritizes thumb-stopping visuals and short captions.
Needs privacy nudges when personal context is unnecessary.
avoid_list: Copyrighted music references as if licensed
acceptance_criteria: Receives energetic behavior options that stay safe for public posting.
Output supports fast iteration and mobile readability.
Prompts redirect away from oversharing private information.

personas.name: Fatima Al Mansoori
personas.accessibility_needs: Needs clear language, right-to-left review awareness, and high contrast
personas.privacy_posture: Very strict; avoids non-public policy details, citizen data, and internal approvals
personas.testing_context: Uses ChatGPT to prepare Adobe Express public information materials that require careful review.
behavior_rules: Requests neutral, official wording with approval checkpoints.
Checks whether content could be interpreted as policy before release.
Asks for bilingual layout awareness without inventing translations as final approved text.
Prefers conservative visuals that prioritize public clarity.
avoid_list: Final legal or official translations without review
acceptance_criteria: Receives cautious public-service behavior flows.
Output includes approval and review reminders.
No restricted government information is introduced.
